steps.en: Install the Core library into an isolated uv environment
steps.zh: 把 Core 库装进隔离的 uv 环境

steps.en: Load any supported model through the drop-in FastLanguageModel class
steps.zh: 用近乎 drop-in 的类加载模型

steps.en: Swaps in hand-written Triton kernels and dynamic 4-bit, so the job fits far less VRAM
steps.zh: 换上 Triton kernel 与动态 4-bit，同任务更省显存

steps.en: Attach LoRA and train with the standard TRL trainer
steps.zh: 挂上 LoRA，用标准 TRL trainer 训练

steps.en: Accelerates each step behind your usual HF script — datasets and adapters stay stock
steps.zh: 照常跑 TRL 脚本，数据与 adapter 仍是标准 HF 资产

value.en: QLoRA on one GPU in far less VRAM at roughly 2x speed (vendor claims), still pure Hugging Face
value.zh: 单卡 QLoRA 更省更快（官方数字），产物仍是标准 HF 资产
